title: Welcome to the Real World: How You Live in Your Own Simulation of Reality — and How We Can Still Share a World. A Theory of Persistence, Emergence, Learning, and Correctable Intelligence
description: Evolution by Emergence is an open research corpus and machine-auditable candidate architecture for resource-constrained cumulative evolution. Version v22.3 tells the theory as one story: CORE.md starts from learning in a neural network, read as a network, and follows it in eight steps, from the ledger to the commons and to intelligence; formalization/ebe-core/EbECore.lean now audits 91 machine-checked results (44 in v22.2). New results cover the commons as the vortex of the whole, reciprocity and partner switching, discounting and the tragedy of the commons, the cost of listening, graded belief, connection against independence, care as a transfer, and power and distribution. Several claims are narrowed, and CORE.md now states how much each result says, which premises are assumed and which literatures each step sits next to. PREDICTIONS.md adds testing discipline and proposed tests of the health of intelligence and of the commons, a new line of concept notes with their research briefs, reports and reviews. DIALOGUE.md records how the author and an AI assistant build the model together. The release title uses ‘simulation of reality’ to mean the internal model through which a system experiences and acts in the world, not a claim that reality itself is simulated. Formal verification establishes implications under explicit premises; empirical, causal, political and normative interpretations remain open.
